tcgplayer_history_depth.missing_day_behavior: Raw rows are observed daily snapshots with a database latest-wins key; raw history is not synthetically forward-filled. Compact V2 events/ranges and as-of readers carry the last observed price state only within retained observation authority. The diagnostic used V2 PRICE events strictly before each target date.
tcgplayer_history_depth.history_maturity: Short: roughly 2.5 months of directly retained daily history for the selected canonical variants and at most 156 source dates/5 monthly buckets in the broader retained system.

trailing_price_return.why: Prior dated card-variant Market Price snapshots exist for 7/14/30/60-day returns.

price_velocity.why: Dated log-price paths support fixed-window slopes.

volatility.why: Variation of provider Market Price snapshots is measurable; it is not transaction-level volatility.

drawdown.why: Current prior snapshot can be compared with rolling historical maxima.

distance_from_rolling_median.why: Daily price histories support rolling medians.

relative_strength_vs_set.why: Canonical set identity and contemporaneous card histories are available; target-self exclusion is required.

relative_strength_vs_era.why: Canonical era joins and contemporaneous histories are available.

price_persistence.why: Compact events identify time since provider price-state change.

stale_price_duration.why: Observation dates and last-change events distinguish capture staleness from unchanged-price duration.

observation_frequency.why: Observed-day counts are available; this is collector frequency, not sales frequency.

cross_source_dispersion.why: There is only one usable card-level provider. TCGplayer low/high are price points from the same provider, not independent sources.

price_level_stability.why: Rolling dispersion and unchanged-state duration are measurable.

recent_vs_long_term_regime.why: Recent windows exist, but no selected card has 90 directly retained observations and only five monthly rollup buckets exist.

set_relative_demand_proxy.why: Set-relative price movement can be built, but without sale counts it is only a price-behavior proxy, not demand or liquidity.

treatment_relative_price_behavior.why: F1 has resolved Treatment V3 and aligned selected-variant histories; general coverage remains identity-dependent.

transaction_grounding.detail: TCGplayer Market Price is based on recent completed sales, but the integration retains only TCGplayer's aggregate Market Price snapshots and listing-derived low/high reference points. No underlying sale rows, quantities, counts, or timestamps are exposed.
transaction_grounding.approved_no_new_paid_access: TCGplayer aggregate Market Price only. eBay Browse provides active listings, not sold transactions. Existing audit marks eBay Marketplace Insights sales history Limited Release/unverified.

diagnostic.purpose: Data-value diagnostic only; no final Fair Value model
diagnostic.estimator: Fixed Ridge(alpha=1.0), log target; median imputation and standardization fit inside each fold
diagnostic.temporal_rule: Every history input is strictly earlier than that row's frozen target_price_date
base_features: log frozen F2R R1_local_residual_10 target-blind prediction
diagnostic.interpretation_limit: The strongest signal is the same card's immediately prior TCGplayer Market Price. This demonstrates short-horizon persistence of the same provider estimate, not independent intrinsic value, transaction-level liquidity, or future-price forecasting.

decision.rationale: Longitudinal card-specific price history adds very large held-root-set-out information and repairs all seven price-band dollar-R2 failures, including the high-value tail. History is nevertheless short, the endpoint exposes only an opaque transaction-derived aggregate, and the diagnostic target is the next/current snapshot from that same provider. The signal is promising for market-conditioned current-value estimation, not sufficient to publish a final Fair Value model.
decision.next_step: Continue append-only daily retention until at least 180 observed days and preferably 12 monthly regimes; freeze a genuinely forward-time validation window before fitting; separate persistence-only lag features from slower return/regime features; seek legitimate sale-count or completed-sale detail for liquidity and high-tail validation; do not use eBay asks as canonical price.
